The 80 files dmu01.txt to dmu80.txt in this folder are the job shop instances of
E. Demirkol, S. Mehta and R. Uzsoy, "Benchmarks for shop scheduling problems", European
Journal of Operational Research 109(1):137-141, 1998, as the ScheduleOpt benchmark collection
distributes them.

           each operation in processing order; machines numbered from 0.
